episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: In need of a big win at work, Na Je-hui plays on Koo Kyung-yi's strengths and weaknesses to enlist her help on a missing person's case.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Kyung-yi suspects there's more to this accident than meets the eye. Reuniting with an old classmate, Song Yi-kyung hears about a former teacher's fate.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A news story about a criminal's light sentence establishes the next target for "K," who sets the scene at a bustling university campus.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Santa's chase after "K" puts the team on high alert, especially Kyung-yi. A spooked co-conspirator distances himself from the criminal mastermind.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Jung Jeong-yeon thinks back to a traumatic incident in her niece's past. Following a hunch that "K" might leave the country, Kyung-yi's team sets a trap.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Kyung-yi sifts through Yi-kyung's playbooks to find out the next target. An outcast's account takes the team to an IT company headed by a public figure.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: In a high-stakes game of cat and mouse, Kyung-yi tries to find and stop the deadly plans Yi-kyung has set in place for Ko Dam's public event.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Yi-kyung's loss plunges her into a world of reckless darkness. Both Yi-kyung and Kyung-yi seek answers on the inexplicable outcome of the event.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Yi Kyung joins hands with Yong Suk, replacing a down-in-the-dumps Kyung Yi who falls out of favor with the strong-handed director.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Kyung Yi inches closer to finding out the truth behind the boat party. Yi Kyung tries to escape the suffocating grasp of Yong Suk's control.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Yong Suk begs for Kyung Yi's help after a video of the yacht party is leaked. Yi Kyung taps a member of Kyung Yi's team for a covert collaboration.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Santa is held hostage by Yi Kyung, who reveals his identity to a disbelieving Kyung Yi. Yong Suk's plans blow up in her face.
